title: 电容的串并联与电压分配
statement: 图中 C_1 = 2 µF，C_2 = 1 µF，C_3 = 3 µF，三个电容原来都不带电。从 t = 0 起，电流源以恒定电流 I_s = 2 mA 给这组电容充电。
求 a、地之间的等效电容 C_eq，以及 t = 10 ms 时的 u_a、u_C1 和 u_C2。

questions.ask: a、地之间的等效电容 C_eq = ?
choiceExplain: 6 µF = 2 + 1 + 3，是把三个电容全部当成并联相加；C_1 与 C_2 ∥ C_3 是串联的。
6/11 µF 是把三个电容全部当成串联（1/C_eq = 1/2 + 1/1 + 1/3）；C_2、C_3 两端接在同样的两个结点上，是并联。
2.75 µF 是按电阻的规则合并电容：C_2 ∥ C_3 按“积除以和”得 0.75 µF，再与 C_1 串联时直接相加；电容正好相反。

questions.explain: C_1 中流过的就是全部电流，q_1 = 20 µC，u_C1 = q_1/C_1 = 20/2 = 10 V。
C_2、C_3 并联，共同得到 20 µC：u_C2 = 20 µC / 4 µF = 5 V。验算：u_C1 + u_C2 = 15 V = u_a ✓。

hints: 电容并联时电容相加（像电阻串联）；串联时 1/C = 1/C_a + 1/C_b（像电阻并联）。先看清哪两个电容接在同样的两个结点上。
恒流充电时送入的电荷 q = I_s·t。原来不带电的串联电容电荷相等，所以电压按电容的倒数分配。
solution: **2. 电荷。** 恒定电流 2 mA 流过 C_1 和 C_23，10 ms 内送入 q = I_s·t = **20 µC**。结点 m 原来不带电，C_1 下极板流出的电荷全部到了 C_2、C_3 的上极板：q_1 = q_2 + q_3 = 20 µC。
**4. 验算。** u_a = q/C_eq = 20/(4/3) = 15 V ✓。串联电容中，电容小的分到的电压大（C_1 = 2 µF 得 10 V，C_23 = 4 µF 得 5 V）。

en.title: Capacitors in series and parallel, voltage sharing
statement: C_1 = 2 µF, C_2 = 1 µF, C_3 = 3 µF, all initially uncharged. From t = 0 on, a current source charges the group with a constant current I_s = 2 mA.
Find the equivalent capacitance C_eq between a and ground, and u_a, u_C1 and u_C2 at t = 10 ms.

questions.ask: Equivalent capacitance between a and ground, C_eq = ?
choiceExplain: 6 µF = 2 + 1 + 3 treats all three capacitors as parallel; C_1 is in series with C_2 ∥ C_3.
6/11 µF treats all three as in series (1/C_eq = 1/2 + 1/1 + 1/3); C_2 and C_3 share the same two nodes, so they are in parallel.
2.75 µF combines capacitors by the resistor rules: C_2 ∥ C_3 as product over sum gives 0.75 µF, then adding C_1 in series; for capacitors the rules are the other way round.
questions.explain: C_2 ∥ C_3 = 1 + 3 = 4 µF (parallel capacitors add); in series with C_1: C_eq = 2 × 4/(2 + 4) = 4/3 µF ≈ 1.333 µF (series capacitors combine as product over sum).
The charge delivered is q = I_s·t = 2×10⁻³ × 0.01 = 20 µC, so u_a = q/C_eq = 20 µC / (4/3 µF) = 15 V.
The whole current flows through C_1, so q_1 = 20 µC and u_C1 = q_1/C_1 = 20/2 = 10 V.
C_2 and C_3 are in parallel and together receive 20 µC: u_C2 = 20 µC / 4 µF = 5 V. Check: u_C1 + u_C2 = 15 V = u_a ✓.

hints: Capacitors in parallel add (like resistors in series); in series 1/C = 1/C_a + 1/C_b (like resistors in parallel). First see which capacitors share the same two nodes.
With a constant charging current the delivered charge is q = I_s·t. Initially uncharged series capacitors carry equal charge, so the voltage divides in inverse proportion to capacitance.
solution: **1. Equivalent capacitance.** C_2 ∥ C_3: C_23 = 1 + 3 = 4 µF. C_1 in series with C_23: C_eq = C_1·C_23/(C_1 + C_23) = 8/6 = **4/3 µF**.

**2. Charge.** The constant 2 mA flows through C_1 and C_23; in 10 ms it delivers q = I_s·t = **20 µC**. Node m was uncharged, so all the charge leaving C_1's lower plate ends up on the upper plates of C_2 and C_3: q_1 = q_2 + q_3 = 20 µC.
**3. Voltages.** u_C1 = q/C_1 = **10 V**; u_C2 = u_C3 = q/C_23 = **5 V** (q_2 = 5 µC, q_3 = 15 µC, shared in proportion to capacitance); u_a = u_C1 + u_C2 = **15 V**.
**4. Check.** u_a = q/C_eq = 20/(4/3) = 15 V ✓. In a series string the smaller capacitor takes the larger voltage (C_1 = 2 µF gets 10 V, C_23 = 4 µF gets 5 V).
